🛡️ Accessibility Disclosure

ThemeMix uses the Accessibility Service API to enable key features such as the customizable Control Center and system controls.

  • Open the Control Center by swiping from the status bar
  • Control media playback
  • Increase or decrease device volume
  • Dismiss system dialogs when required by app features
This permission is used only for user-requested features and does not allow ThemeMix to collect, store, or share personal or sensitive user data through the Accessibility Service API.
